candidates.description: A professional-grade implementation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using the Spring AI framework. This project demonstrates how to integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) like Google Gemini with local vector storage to create context-aware AI applications.

A hands-on learning repository for building AI-powered applications in Java.  Covers the two major frameworks in the Java AI ecosystem — LangChain4j and Spring AI — through progressively complex labs, from streaming output to full RAG pipelines.

MedExtract AI is a high-precision medical data extraction framework built with Java 21, Spring Boot, and LangChain4j. It utilizes a "Small-to-Big" (Parent Document) Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pattern to ensure medical headers (like Patient Names) are never lost during semantic search, even when using local LLMs.
